title: Investigation of proteinkinase (RSK2)-dependent signal transduction and of the transcriptome in human blood vessels
summary: This study  investigates the contribution of newly discoverd mechanisms that contribute to the constriction of small human arteries. The study tests if new findings on arterial function obtained in experimental animals can be translated to humans. In addition, ribonucleic acid expression patterns of small arteries from different parts of the human ciculation will be characterized. The artery samples are obtained from tissue specimens from patients who underwent elective surgery. The surgical removal of the tissue is regular part of the surgical interventions independent of the participation of the patients in this study.
